scope: Current REACT2024 alpha=1.5 operating point evaluated on full VAL1124.

evaluation_contract.gt_matching: all opposite-role GT from the same session
evaluation_contract.metrics: official FRC, exact FRD, FRDiv, FRVar, FRDvs, and TLCC/FRSyn
evaluation_contract.prediction_postprocess: official range projection and AU rounding, followed by query-0 sparse constant-AU transitions

inference_calibration.input: soft 25D student predictions, before AU rounding

query0_sparse_transition.rule: constant zero/one changes at one interior frame selected from the corresponding source AU maximum/minimum
query0_sparse_transition.source_constant_policy: leave the prediction unchanged when any source-face channel is constant

caveats: The accepted alpha was selected on validation data and is not an independent TEST claim.
Alpha=1.5 improves FRC, FRDiv, FRVar, and FRDvs but worsens exact FRD and FRSyn relative to alpha=1.0.
Official TLCC returns after query 0 and is numerically dominated by constant-channel NaNs.
FRRea remains unavailable because the current evaluation cache contains facial attributes rather than rendered real/fake image folders required by FID.
